title: Starry Form: Dragon
html:
Starry Form: Dragon is a bonus action available to Circle of the Stars druids. It lets them enter a  Starry Form where they gain a radiant breath attack and significant bonus to concentration saving throws. At higher levels, druids in this form additionally gain the ability to hover and fly.

Description

A constellation of a wise dragon appears on you. When you make a  Saving Throw to maintain Concentration on a spell, a roll result of 9 or lower is considered a 10.

As a  Bonus Action while in this Starry Form, you can cast  Dazzling Breath.

Properties

Cost
 Bonus Action +  Wild Shape Charge
Details
 Range: Self
Duration: Until Long rest

At higher levels

  • At level 2, Dazzling Breath does 2d6 + Wisdom modifier⁠Radiant damage.
  • At level 5, Dazzling Breath does 3d6 + Wisdom modifier⁠Radiant damage.
  • At level 10,  Twinkling Constellations upgrades this form with the ability to hover and  Fly. Dazzling Breath does 4d6 + Wisdom modifier⁠Radiant damage.

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 2: Circle of the Stars

This spell is a variation of:
Starry Form

Notes

  • This action is listed in the  Wild Shape container action along with the normal Wild Shape forms.
  • The level 10 upgrade makes the druid 'hover' while in dragon form. This grants immunity to all surface effects and fall damage; however, the character still uses normal walking animations and does not visually appear to be hovering. This effect is equivalent to the surface immunity provided by a Swarmkeeper's  Writhing Tide.
  • Note that scripted cutscenes and conversations before combat automatically dismiss Wild Shape (e.g., the conversations before the battle of raiding the Emerald Grove). This could seriously sabotage the fight once combat starts if the player character is unaware.[verify]

Bugs

  • After taking this action, characters receive both a condition and a passive with the same name, 'Starry Form: Dragon', yet they have different descriptions. Starry Form: Dragon only affects concentration saving throws and does not affect any ability checks or other  Constitution Saving Throws despite the passive stating otherwise:
When you make Intelligence or Wisdom Checks or Constitution Saving Throws, you can replace rolls of 9 or lower with a 10.
